limits: Focused automated rendering, settings, native parity, and menu-to-first-zone loading. No gameplay playthroughs.
Linux on RTX 3090 Ti; Android on Retroid Pocket 5 / Adreno 650. Original reported Adreno 610 and RTX 3050/CachyOS hardware unavailable.
Windows and macOS are cross-built and statically audited; physical target-OS execution was not performed.

The earlier unexpected Retroid reboot remains unexplained. Every final Android run retains monotonic uptime, including Compatibility first-zone startup and Mobile settings/cloud checks. This does not prove its cause fixed.
Optional Adreno 650 Mobile water flicker remains under investigation. Android defaults to Compatibility and retains constrained-platform sheet clouds.
Final Android runtime checks use a private application ID. Every engine/helper byte and all 270 production scripts match the signed public APK except the explicit private Main entry hook.

excluded_harness_attempts.android-presets: The fixture completed 57 checks/0 failures, but the runner requested a JSON receipt that this fixture did not write. Added a test-only receipt and reran successfully as android-presets-receipt.
excluded_harness_attempts.android-first-load: The private dispatcher attached the tool one node below Main, so the menu signal received a null callable before attempting New Game. Corrected the private dispatcher; android-first-load02 exercises the actual Main/Session path and passes.

template.libcxx_note: The new build copies an unstripped NDK29 library; stripping it reproduces the exact release/private template bytes.

release_template_provenance.libcxx_note: The new build copies an unstripped NDK29 library; stripping it reproduces the exact release/private template bytes.

river_design: Extend only wet connected same-material reaches with an authored slope seed; preserve exclusions for sea, lava, swamp, emissive and buried layers.
Infer upstream/downstream from the slope; guide flat-reach direction with bank normals, then retain the existing tent smoothing.
No new per-frame field calculation, texture, sampler or change to gameplay/navigation heights. Final map fields match native/scalar exactly on Linux and Android.
Seven-metre-wide flat authored zone8 patch has visible current and downstream contact foam; pause, clock reset, phase wrap and still-water controls pass on GLES and Forward+.
